I am using Renderer to manage focus and when I changed it to RendererV2 I'm getting compile error. 
Property 'invokeElementMethod' does not exist on type 'RendererV2'. 
Is Renderer going away and RendererV2 the latest? If this is so I have to get Focus to work again.
re:   this.renderer.invokeElementMethod(this.elContinue, 'focus');

BTW: I did not see any deprecated warning about "Renderer" but see notes in code "Note: `Renderer` can still be injected/used, but is deprecated."  Anyway... rc2 is still young and not as breaking as Angular2 rc-4 to rc-5 with @modules which was worth the effort. Best
